name: Kaguya
source:
He is gentle and courteous to everyone, no matter who -- his smile never fades. Since he has a way with women, he has many relationships with them. His peculiar way of speaking that resembles Kansai dialect, along with his slightly eccentric appearance, cause him to look a bit out of place.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/10/17/taisho-alice-introduction/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
